case: open top (case top panel removed); 1 GPU (RTX 5090); front 3× SWP4 intake onto the GPU, 1× SWP4 rear exhaust
case_fans: Case fans ×4 (be quiet! Silent Wings Pro 4 120 mm)
radiator_note: held on its own curve (Curve 1), logged
steady: |dT/dt| < 0.2 °C/min over 120 s (core, memory, hot spot), min 150 s, max 480 s per point; mean of last 60 s
abort: memory ≥ 88 °C, hot spot ≥ 95 °C, core ≥ 88 °C (NVML slowdown − 5) → point marked too_hot, all fans 100 % until cool, next point
mode: fast: full 8×5 grid, point = 10 s skip + 60 s fit (first-order T∞, τ, ±95 %); every 4th point and the reference point (start/middle/end) run to steady state (max 360 s) to validate the extrapolation
